description: Set the cover-image field and crop/fit mode for Kanban or Gallery views. Pass `coverColumnId: null` to remove the cover. Either field can be passed independently — the other is left untouched.

coverColumnId.description: Attachment field ID to use as cover (or null to remove)

coverFitType.description: How the cover image is displayed

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

name: set_view_cover
